context.viewer_after: A separately labeled derived guide may pass the tail gate without implying that human listening or final delivery has passed.

data.choice: Create separate candidate copies of the Short 03 and 04 guides by appending 0.5 seconds of digital zero after the original last sample, leaving all original PCM samples and raw provider responses unchanged. Re-probe and re-run exact-copy ASR before any Original C transfer; defer owner listening to the finished private-review videos as requested.
data.reason: Short 03 has two independent exact 98-word local ASR reads and decays near zero. Short 04 has two exact 126-word local reads and includes the final business sentence; its last sample is nonzero, so a faint join click remains a specific risk for final review. A zero append is a bounded mechanical tail repair, not a claim to restore missing phonemes.

alternatives.reason_not_selected: The locked words appear present and paid retries are outside the first-pass operational limits; test the lossless derived candidate first.
Both fail the established technical tail gate.

reuse.applies_when: Only these exact EP007 Short 03 and Short 04 guide WAVs and their present QC evidence.
reuse.avoid_when: A source lacks final locked words, has a hard-clipped syllable, or a different take would require a new paid call.

nuance.false_inference: Appending silence does not repair truncated speech, certify naturalness, or authorize release.
nuance.before_transfer: derived file hash, original-prefix PCM equality, decoded format and duration, tail metric and exact-copy ASR must be recorded

data.scope: Reversible local derived media and subsequent technical verification only. No new paid provider attempt, no change to locked words or original guide files, no owner acceptance or release.
